# Credits

Techniques adapted (rewritten, no files copied):

- Spear faces its velocity in flight and sticks on impact: marcelisdead/WreckBow (`FlyStraight.cs`, `NonKineCollision.cs`), https://github.com/marcelisdead/WreckBow, CC0-1.0.
- Kinematic body parts switched to dynamic on hit (ragdoll on impact): mixandjam/Superhot-BulletTime (`EnemyScript.Ragdoll`), https://github.com/mixandjam/Superhot-BulletTime, MIT.
- Launch angle for a fixed projectile speed (bot aim): mnijaki/AutoAimBowAndArrow (`VelocityBasedProjectileLauncher.cs`), https://github.com/mnijaki/AutoAimBowAndArrow, MIT.

Fonts:

- Barlow Bold and ExtraBold by The Barlow Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`Assets/SpearDrop/Fonts/OFL.txt`).
- TextMesh Pro Essential Resources include Liberation Sans, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
